search_text: published ZDI-16-482 ZDI-CAN-3549 Samsung Security Manager ActiveMQ Broker Service MOVE Method Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-08-18 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Samsung'] ['Security Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Samsung Security Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the ActiveMQ Broker service that is installed as part of this product. By issuing an HTTP PUT request and an HTTP MOVE request, an attacker can create an arbitrary file on the server with attacker controlled data. An attacker can further leverage this vulnerability to execute code on the server as SYSTEM. Samsung has issued an update to correct this vulnerability.
